> FAQs

We’ve got answers.

Real-world usages.

//

001

What can I build with this?

You can build AI-powered automation workflows, smart data processing pipelines, content generation tools, and intelligent task routing systems. C²&D² is designed for any product that needs to process inputs, apply reasoning, and deliver structured outputs — from internal tools to customer-facing features.

//

002

Do I need AI or machine learning experience?

No. C²&D² abstracts the underlying AI complexity through clean APIs and workflow primitives. You define what you need — inputs, tasks, and expected outputs — and C²&D² handles the rest. Basic programming knowledge is enough to get started.

//

003

How does integration work?

Install the SDK via npm, pip, or CLI — setup takes under five minutes. Authenticate with your API key, define your workflow, and start sending requests. C²&D² returns structured outputs you can plug directly into your existing application logic.

//

004

Can it work with my current tools?

Yes. C²&D² is built to fit into existing stacks without replacing them. It integrates with common data sources, APIs, and platforms. If your tool can send an HTTP request or run a script, it can connect to C²&D².

//

005

Is it suitable for production use?

Yes. C²&D² is designed with reliability and consistency in mind — the same input produces the same quality output every time. Teams already use it in live products and automated pipelines, with monitoring and priority support available on higher plans.
